Author: rockerudon
Name: Allagan Retro Pocket
Punchline: A multi-system Libretro emulator that runs inside FFXIV.
Description:
Import your ROM library and play supported retro games without leaving FFXIV. Allagan Retro Pocket runs Libretro cores in-game with per-system controls, controller support, save states, memory-card saves, firmware management and quick gameplay controls.

Command:
/retro — Open Allagan Retro Pocket.
